decisions.why: the site carries no division structure so the whole flat range (14 items) was read: Operating Tables, Operating Lights, Examination Lights, Theatre Control Panels and Clinical Pendants are named products in the range - Starkstrom is a theatre integration specialist and the range as a whole is sold as operating-theatre capital equipment/OR integration (theatres:capital), which is the framework's own description of the award (Operating Theatres Equipment and Related Accessories and Services). A handful of items (Isolated/Uninterruptible Power Supply, Earthing and Sockets, Battery Backup, Illuminated Warning Signs, PACS) are theatre-building electrical infrastructure rather than tables/lights themselves, but sit within the same integrated theatre-fit-out range with no separate division to split them into - left under theatres:capital rather than invented a second category with no supporting evidence.
